text:
nora-cs: FreightPro just escalated — after last night's model runtime push they're seeing invoice summaries that include other customers' PO numbers and duplicated paragraphs. Ticket CS-9654. Paste of customer repro below.

devops-bot: rollout: rwd-runtime:v2.14.1 promoted -> stable @ 2026-03-22T01:04:10Z :rocket:

nora-cs: customer repro:
- prompt: "Summarize invoice and next steps for settlement for PO [PO: FP-2044, amount $8,750, customer: FreightPro]"
- expected: "1) Confirm $8,750; 2) Send invoice to accounts@freightpro.com..."
- observed: repeated stanza "Send invoice to accounts@freightpro.com" and once included "PO: BL-7782" (another tenant)

jose-infra: quick read: v2.14.1 introduced a 'prefix_salt' reorder in the prefix key composition (we moved session-id before model-name). There is also an edge cache layer (kv-edge) that has lax provenance checks for perf. If edge cached an entry computed with old ordering, the new ordering may hash to an existing key and the provenance check didn't always block serving.

ravi-runtime: found correlated logs for FreightPro request ids. excerpt:

```
[2026-03-22T01:10:12Z] req=fp-11 kv-edge lookup key=0x9f2 hit=true owner=tenant:freightpro pv=21
[2026-03-22T01:10:12Z] req=fp-11 kv-edge computed_key=0x3b7
[2026-03-22T01:10:12Z] req=fp-11 kv-edge provenance_check=partial_pass
[2026-03-22T01:10:12Z] req=fp-11 served_from=kv-edge
```

ravi-runtime: note `provenance_check=partial_pass` — that's the bug. Edge performs a lightweight check that compared tenant id but not prefix_version when response size < 8k to avoid extra metadata roundtrip. New key ordering exposed this.

emma-evals: can we produce a sandbox repro for CS to demonstrate? Prefer sandboxes so we don't invalidate prod caches unless approved.

nora-cs: sandbox curl (SANDBOX only):

```
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer SANDBOX_TOKEN" \n  -H "X-Session-ID: sess-fp-2044" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-instruct-1","prompt":"Summarize invoice and next steps for PO [PO: FP-2044, amount $8,750, customer: FreightPro]","prefix_version":21}'
```

nora-cs: results — sandbox nodes with old runtime return good output; nodes with v2.14.1 reproduce duplication/wrong PO.

jose-infra: mitigation options:
1) Targeted: invalidate kv-edge entries for FreightPro pv=21 (fast, low risk). Use `redwood-admin kv-invalidate --tenant freightpro --prefix-version 21 --edge --dry-run` then `--confirm`.
2) Short rollback: revert kv-edge to v2.14 for a full stop-gap (higher disruption).
3) Medium: deploy a compatibility path in kv-edge that accepts both old/new key encodings and upgrades entries on serve with strict full provenance check.

ravi-runtime: invalidation will mitigate immediate symptoms but we must fix edge provenance to avoid reoccurrence. I'll add a runtime assert that treats partial_provenance as miss and logs for audit.

kai-qa: QA checklist before invalidate:
- capture kv-edge stats and list candidate keys (`--dry-run`) and save snapshot
- run a canary invalidate on sandbox tenant
- monitor request ids and error rates during and after

nora-cs: ran dry-run on staging — 9 candidate edge keys surfaced. ran confirm during a 30min maintenance window with customer approval. Commands used:

```
# dry run
redwood-admin kv-invalidate --tenant freightpro --prefix-version 21 --edge --dry-run > /tmp/kv-dryrun-fp-21.log
# execute
redwood-admin kv-invalidate --tenant freightpro --prefix-version 21 --edge --confirm
# tail logs for related request ids
rg "req=fp-11|sess-fp-2044" /var/log/redwood/edge/*.log | sed -n '1,200p'
```

nora-cs: FreightPro verified their sample prompt returns correct output post-flush. They've asked for 24h monitoring and a 5% credit; CS proposed that and customer accepted.

ops-bot: action created: ops-2521 (owner: jose-infra) - investigate kv-edge provenance checks and recovery plan :lock: 

ravi-runtime: opened PR to treat partial_provenance as miss, add full metadata comparison (tenant + prefix_version + salt) before serving cached payload. Also adding telemetry event `kv_provenance_mismatch` for quick dashboards.

emma-evals: adding regression: simulate rolling upgrade with mixed key encodings at edge and assert no cross-tenant content is served. Also add fuzz tests for `prefix_salt` reorderings.

jose-infra: post-incident todo:
- CHORE: strict provenance in kv-edge (ravi) - P0
- CHORE: compatibility upgrade path and migrate keys to new encoding (jose) - P1
- DOC: update rollout checklist to include `kv-edge` compatibility verification (nora-cs) - P1
- OPS: include `--edge` flag and dry-run output in incident runbook (jose) - P1
- CX: record mitigation and credit in billing incident tracker (nora-cs) - P2

nora-cs: closing thread; will reopen if FreightPro reports further issues. Thanks all :heart:
